site.title: Satellite Temperature Advisor
site.metadataDescription: Open-Meteo-backed temperature guidance with deterministic advisories for households and grocery operations.

home.heading: Temperature adviser for groceries and neighbours.
home.intro: Register as a shopper or grocer, confirm via email through Supabase Auth, and receive rule-based summaries built on Open‑Meteo numerical forecasts—with explicit links back to EU and US authoritative programmes.
home.step1: Choose household or grocery onboarding after email verification.
home.step2: Save latitude, longitude, and temperature thresholds.
home.step3: Open-Meteo provides hourly temperatures; deterministic rules summarise risk.
home.step4: Secured cron job emails digests via Resend (configure your keys).
home.noteBox: No third-party meteorological API keys needed for forecasting. Alerts require Resend and Supabase service credentials for secure batching.
home.honestBody: This demo does not run raw satellite ingestion. Instead it pairs trusted global model output (via Open‑Meteo) with satellite science references so teams can escalate to calibrated sensors when it matters—for walk-in coolers, loading docks, and community preparedness.

login.subtitleBefore: Access your temperature advisor dashboard. New here?

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitleBefore: Households and grocery teams each get email verification through Supabase Auth. Already registered?
signUp.grocery: A grocery store or food retail team

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a confirmation link from Supabase Auth. Click it to activate your account and land on onboarding. You can close this tab after you verify.

onboarding.title: Finish your Satellite Temperature Advisor profile
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us whether you're optimizing a household plan or refrigerated operations for a food retail site. Threshold alerts and dashboards use this context in copy — not pricing or permissions in v1.
onboarding.addressPlaceholder: Street, city — used for your own records in v1

errors.STORE_NAME_REQUIRED: Store name is required for grocery accounts.

dashboard.advisorySubtitle: Preview uses your saved coordinates or NYC defaults until you save a subscription.
dashboard.advisoryUnavailable: Forecast preview unavailable. Configure coordinates/timezone below and ensure network access is allowed for Open-Meteo.
dashboard.advisoryAttribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo (Commercial use requires attribution; see References). Forecasts are model guidance — supplement with calibrated sensors on site.
dashboard.alertSubtitle: Configure where we email temperature digests. Cron jobs should call the secured API route using {secret} — see README.

form.countryHint: Choosing a country sets the legal timezone for alerts; pick a region below for precise coordinates.
form.coordsHint: Set automatically from the region you select.
form.timezoneHintOther: Enter a valid IANA zone (e.g. America/New_York) when your location is not listed.
form.timezoneHint: Derived from the country (and from the region only where multiple zones apply, e.g. México or Brasil).
form.minAlertHint: Email highlights when modeled air min drops under this value in the lookahead window.
form.maxAlertHint: Highlights when modeled air max climbs above this value.

errors.NOT_SIGNED_IN: Sign in again to configure alerts.
errors.GENERIC: We couldn't save your alert settings.

stable.title: Stable conditions
stable.summary: Near-surface temperatures in the next day look within typical ranges for your alert settings.

frostWatch.title: Cold / frost watch
frostWatch.summary: Hourly guidance suggests surface air may approach frost-prone values. Ground and soil temperatures can lag or diverge from air readings.
frostWatch.bullet: Consider protecting outdoor intake areas and verifying HVAC setpoints overnight.
frostWatch.soil: Soil temperature (model layer ~6 cm average in window) centered near {soil}°C — helpful context, not a replacement for probes.

heatStress.title: Heat stress window
heatStress.summary: Hot peak temperatures are expected. Satellite-informed land context still benefits from point sensors at the store.
heatStress.bullet: Verify cold-chain for short trips from truck to shelf; peak sun on asphalt can exceed air temperature.

seasonalBlend.title: Mixed temperature stress window
seasonalBlend.summary: The next day may include both chilly lows and strong daytime heat — plan for refrigerated inventory and hydrated crews.

thresholdOnly.title: Within model range but past your alert thresholds
thresholdOnly.summary: Rule-based checks flagged your custom limits even if broader risk labels stay calm — see breach detail below.

advisory.defaultBullet: Forecasts blend global models; always compare with local instruments for loading docks and display cases.
advisory.breachCold: Air temperature may drop near or below {threshold}°C ({observed}°C in the next-day window); review cold-chain and frost-sensitive goods.
advisory.breachHotOnly: Peak temperature may exceed {threshold}°C (~{observed}°C); monitor refrigerated cases and staffing comfort.
